Area.evidence_source: While there is an increased prevalence of suicide among young gay men (Bagley & Tremblay 2000; Sandfort et al. 1999), many seeking professional help often experience institutional heterosexism and homophobia (King et al. 2003; PACE 1998). Mental health nurses clinging to the familiarity of heterosexism increase the risk of denigrating those with a gay identity to a life of social exclusion (King et al. 2003; Phillips & Silling 1997).
